description: Generate a legal policy (privacy policy, terms of service, cookie policy, refund policy, EULA, or disclaimer) for a business and return its Markdown content plus a hosted URL. Consumes one policy from the account's quota. IMPORTANT: if you are working inside the user's project, call get_disclosure_checklist and scan the codebase FIRST (dependencies, script tags, cookie writes, outbound hosts), then fill the optional fields below from what the code actually does — do not ask the user for facts you can read from source. Only ask for what code cannot tell you: legal company name, contact email, physical address, governing law.

children_data.description: Does it knowingly collect data from children?

consent_tracking.description: Enable the "I agree" consent banner on the hosted page (default false).

contact_email.description: Public contact email for legal inquiries.

cookies.description: Does it use cookies? Defaults to true for most websites.

data_collection.description: Categories of personal data collected, e.g. ["email","name","usage"].

data_retention.description: How long data is kept, e.g. "24 months".

dpo_email.description: Data Protection Officer email, if any. Also sets hasDPO.

governing_law.description: Governing law jurisdiction, e.g. "State of California, USA".

hosting_enabled.description: Host the policy at a public policyforge.co URL (default true).

jurisdiction.description: Target legal framework(s). One or more of: gdpr, ccpa, pipeda, lgpd, us, eu, ca, uk, au, br, global, Europe, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Brazil, India, Singapore, Japan, Mexico. Combine multiple comma-separated, e.g. "gdpr,ccpa". Country/region names are case-sensitive as listed.

sells_data.description: Does it sell or share personal data?

service_description.description: Short description of what the product or service does.

stack_manifest.description: Structured summary of the stack you detected while scanning the codebase (see get_disclosure_checklist), e.g. {"analytics":["posthog"],"payments":["stripe"],"auth":["supabase"],"ai_features":["openai"],"cookies":["session"],"jurisdiction_signals":["EU locales"]}. Stored server-side so check_policy_freshness can detect drift when the stack changes later. Provide it whenever you scanned the project.

table_of_contents.description: Add a linked table of contents to the generated document. Requires a Pro plan.

type.description: The kind of policy to generate.

user_accounts.description: Does the product have user accounts?

name: generate_policy
title: Generate policy
